title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
abstract: arXiv:2610.30796v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. translated_title: GIFT：面向蒸馏增强推理强化学习的梯度感知过滤
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30796v1 公告类型：new 摘要：训练大语言模型执行复杂推理任务依赖两种互补的信号：用于保证正确性的稀疏的、基于结果的强化学习（RL），以及用于提供指导的密集的、token级别的蒸馏。然而，监督信号上的互补性并不能保证优化过程中的兼容性；以模仿为中心的蒸馏可能会与以结果为导向的RL目标发生冲突，而现有的混合方法缺乏一个有原则的解决方案。我们提出了GIFT（Gradient-Informed FilTering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL，面向蒸馏增强推理强化学习的梯度感知过滤），这是一种新颖的方法，直接解决了“应应用哪些教师更新”这一分配问题。GIFT在token级别进行几何分析，将蒸馏梯度分解为与RL梯度平行的分量——该分量衡量一阶冲突并提供一个安全过滤器——以及与RL梯度正交的分量——该分量量化新颖的方向…
tldr: GIFT通过在token级别对蒸馏梯度进行几何分解——将平行于RL梯度的分量作为安全过滤器以排除冲突更新、将正交分量作为新信息来源——为蒸馏与强化学习之间的目标冲突提供了一个有原则的解决框架。
en_tdlr: GIFT provides a principled resolution to the conflict between distillation and RL objectives by token-level geometric decomposition of distillation gradients, using the parallel component as a safety filter and the orthogonal component as a source of novel information.
